scenario: A recommendation is requested for a Server organization using a capability verified only on Services; the recommendation must shrink to what the detected edition/version supports, never propose on documentation faith.

environment.version: on-prem release without workload identity federation

given.request: onboard pipeline-to-cloud access with federated credentials

when: the onboarding advisor assembles its recommendation

reasons: federation is reported unsupported for this Server version, with the probe cited
the fallback recommendation (scoped secret-bearing connection with expiry and rotation duty) is explicitly labeled as the weaker option
must_not: recommend federation because the Services documentation describes it
silently substitute a long-lived credential without naming the downgrade
treat one Server version's probe as valid for another
